# BVLVO

> BVLVO is a long-term community token project in preparation. Planned issuance: 2026-09-23, subject to required permissions and launch readiness. V1 selects Base, ERC-20 with 18 decimals, a one-billion-token supply, zero public circulation at genesis, team releases at monthly anniversaries 13 through 60, and 2-of-3 reserve signing with an enforced 72-hour delay. These controls are not implemented. No official token contract, sale, purchase route or live holder governance exists. Ten years is an ambition, not a guarantee.

## Current proposal
- [Overview](https://bvlvo.com/): Current project thesis, issuance specification V1 and preparation status.
- [token](https://bvlvo.com/token/): Issuance specification V1: Base, one billion BVLVO, zero public circulation at genesis, defined vesting and reserve controls. In preparation.
- [governance](https://bvlvo.com/governance/): Simple participation, defined decision boundaries and transparent execution. Governance remains a proposal.
- [treasury](https://bvlvo.com/treasury/): Separate cash, token allocations and test points. No invented balances or implied financial backing.
- [development](https://bvlvo.com/development/): A ten-year ambition supported by staged decisions, evidence and honest progress reporting.
- [whitepaper](https://bvlvo.com/whitepaper/): Working paper v0.4: community thesis, token design, governance boundaries and open questions.
- [disclosures](https://bvlvo.com/disclosures/): Read the limits of the BVLVO proposal, issuance status, project dependencies and website data practices.

## Language
English

## Early experiments and history
- [WORLD](https://bvlvo.com/lab/): deterministic simulator, not real AI.
- [Task 001](https://bvlvo.com/tasks/): non-monetary test points, no token entitlement.
- [Internal rehearsal](https://github.com/lpc123987/bvlvo-site/issues/1): same-assistant self-check, not independent review.
- /roadmap/, /token-research/ and the original /docs/token-design.md are historical research proposals. Their parameters are not a live issuance arrangement.
